name: GDPR Data Privacy & Protection Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), covering Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA), Lawful Basis for Processing, Data Subject Rights (DSAR), Sub-processor DPAs, and 72-hour Supervisory Authority breach notifications.
owner: Data Protection Officer (DPO) & Privacy Legal Office

checklists.name: GDPR Privacy & Data Subject Rights Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for GDPR Article 5 principles, Articles 12-22 Data Subject Rights, and Article 35 DPIAs.

items.statement: Lawful basis for processing (Consent, Legitimate Interest, Contract Performance) is documented for every PII data category.
Automated mechanisms support Data Subject Access Requests (DSAR), Export (JSON/CSV), and Right to be Forgotten within 30 days.
Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) is completed and signed off by the DPO for high-risk processing operations.
Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs) are in place for non-EU data transfers.
Incident response plan guarantees notification to Supervisory Authorities within 72 hours of discovering a personal data breach.

reviewGates.name: GDPR DPA & Privacy Attestation Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Data Protection Officer (DPO) and Legal Counsel attest that personal data processing, DPIA, consent mechanics, and DSAR workflows satisfy GDPR requirements.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Data Protection Officer confirm that DPIA, DSAR automation, and GDPR privacy controls are fully compliant?
